title: LAP4 FY 2027: approved 30 Diamond changes update the planning basis but do not establish production capability
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: NNSA requests $812.1 million for LAP4 in FY 2027 and reports an approved current planning basis of $5.865353 billion with CD-4 in the fourth quarter of FY 2032; approved 30 Diamond baseline changes are reflected while two remaining subprojects were anticipated for baselining in FY 2026. Denominator: The five-subproject LAP4 construction project and its current planning basis; the FY 2027 request comprises $762.029 million TEC and $50.071 million OPC.
key_findings: Finding: NNSA requests $812.1 million for LAP4 in FY 2027 and reports an approved current planning basis of $5.865353 billion with CD-4 in the fourth quarter of FY 2032; approved 30 Diamond baseline changes are reflected while two remaining subprojects were anticipated for baselining in FY 2026.

Boundary: The overall project estimate has not been updated since CD-1 and full TPC awaits baselining of every subproject.
Boundary: An annual request and approved baseline changes are not completed installation, CD-4, operational acceptance, or 30-pit-per-year capability.
Boundary: This project planning basis is not the complete multi-site pit-production capability lifecycle estimate.
Next action: Track each subproject's CD-2/3, approved scope, construction, equipment installation, CD-4, operational acceptance, and attributable production contribution.
